build_ray_gauge_metric: build a Ray gauge metric wrapper that sets numeric values with automatic ReplicaId labels
create_ray_counter_metric: create a Ray counter metric wrapper that increments counters with automatic ReplicaId labels
build_ray_histogram_metric: build a Ray histogram metric wrapper that observes values with automatic ReplicaId labels
create_ray_stat_logger: create a Ray Prometheus stat logger that uses Ray metrics instead of prometheus_client
create_ray_kv_connector_prom: create a Ray KV connector prometheus metrics class using Ray gauge, counter, and histogram wrappers
